originalRecord.rule: MDC-026/MDC-046: scope changes must not relabel one source's state as another vehicle's state.
originalRecord.mechanism: Configuration hydration runs only while the component-lifetime hydrated flag is false. The effect does not reset that flag or the enabled/coordinate/target drafts when vehicleId changes. EmergencyResiliencePage:112 mounts the same unkeyed StormGuardPanel and passes the current selected vehicle. After one vehicle's configuration hydrates, another selected vehicle's stored configuration cannot hydrate the draft, while handleSave binds the unchanged draft to the new vehicle_id.
originalRecord.impact: A retained draft can represent a different vehicle than the selected workspace and status query; a subsequent user save would use the current vehicle ID with the previous draft.
originalRecord.evidenceLimit: Static component/effect/mutation-argument trace only. No real identity, coordinate, vehicle switch, save, command or backend behavior was exercised.
originalRecord.suggestedFollowup: Separately lease vehicle-scoped draft/hydration lifecycle handling that preserves deliberate unsaved edits within their original scope and rejects old-scope hydration; do not change source in this QA item.

originalRecord.suggestedFollowup: Use the existing preference-bound date formatter at these direct rendering owners in a separately leased change.

originalRecord.rule: MDC-026: unresolved/error evidence is not authoritative empty or unsupported evidence.
originalRecord.detail: EvidencePanel receives payload fields but no query/state/error/retry metadata. Its inner InsightPanel uses the default empty=false with no query and therefore resolves ready even before a response exists. During first loading, first paused load, first failure, or no selection, it states 'Quality metadata is unsupported.', 'No supporting evidence was returned.', and 'No additional limitations were returned.'. originalRecord.confidence: HIGH: deterministic props/branch trace; no runtime or production response claim.

originalRecord.rule: MDC-023/MDC-026: unknown totals are not zero; recovery must keep the real requested page reachable.
originalRecord.detail: On page 2 with no cached page-2 response, total defaults to zero while the requested page remains 2. Pagination's exact-total mode clamps its safePage to 1 and disables previous/next. If that new page fails, the page's correction effect exits on query.error, leaving the request at page 2 while navigation displays page 1 of an empty result. A direct jump to 1 also does not call onPageChange because it equals Pagination's synthetic safePage. This prevents using the pagination controls to recover to the cached first page.
originalRecord.mechanism: page=2 + query.data undefined -> total=0 -> totalPages=1 -> safePage=1 -> previous disabled; form target=1 equals safePage and suppresses callback; error prevents the parent's clamp effect.
sourceDerivedRepro: Start from a synthetic first-page success with total=36 and advance to page 2; the new query key has no cached data.
Reason over page=2, query.data=undefined and query.error set after the page-2 load fails.
Pagination receives page=2,total=0,pageSize=18, but computes safePage=1 and disables previous/next; entering 1 produces no callback. Only retrying the failing page or changing broader scope remains.
originalRecord.confidence: HIGH: valid query-state transition and explicit clamping/callback predicates.
originalRecord.fix: Preserve the requested page and last known total for the same vehicle, or use the existing unknown-total contract while the new page has no response. Do not infer an empty full result or disable the previous-page recovery route from missing query.data.

originalRecord.title: Exclusive end is applied inclusively by the vehicle-state repository
originalRecord.mechanism: Both hooks serialize endInstantExclusive as end, but timelineSelectSQL uses ts <= $3. Summary calls that same Timeline query. A transition exactly at the intended exclusive boundary is included in timeline/daily counts and can add a zero-dwell summary transition entry; adjacent windows can count the same boundary event.
originalRecord.owner: Narrow backend vehicle-state window-contract owner: internal\database\vehicle\states_repo.go plus directly covering repository/handler tests. Hook/handler contract review by API owner; no backend edits authorized here.
originalRecord.proposed_scope: Align this endpoint's upper-bound semantics with the existing workspace [start,endExclusive) contract; cover exact boundary and adjacent windows without changing unrelated APIs.
originalRecord.runtime_status: NOTRUN; source predicate and caller contract establish the mismatch.

originalRecord.title: Final transition dwell extends historical windows to wall-clock now
originalRecord.mechanism: The final in-window row always has next_ts=null, and transitionDuration uses Date.now rather than the requested exclusive end or an evidence-backed successor. For a past window the table/mobile/preview duration keeps extending after that window and can disagree with bounded summary suffix dwell. Absence of a successor inside a bounded query does not establish current state.
originalRecord.owner: Narrow TimelinePage duration owner, with directly covering TimelinePage tests.
originalRecord.proposed_scope: Make row-duration semantics explicitly requested-window/evidence bounded; preserve minute-rounding and all table/mobile/preview uses. Do not claim current-state duration from a bounded historical list.
originalRecord.runtime_status: NOTRUN; Date.now and missing successor construction are directly observed source.

originalRecord.title: Unavailable dwell evidence becomes zero-valued summary duration
originalRecord.mechanism: Array.isArray(by_state) alone makes summarySource available. Missing driving/charging/grouped state rows become 0 via ?? 0, and an empty by_state makes all dwell metrics show 0m. The repository returns []/0 when there are no in-window transitions, not a continuous zero-dwell observation; a null first from_state also leaves prefix coverage unknown. The page already labels observation completeness unknown, so array availability is insufficient evidence for per-state measured-zero dwell.
originalRecord.owner: Narrow TimelinePage summary-evidence adapter owner. An API owner may separately specify coverage/absence metadata; do not invent it in this page.
originalRecord.proposed_scope: Keep zero transition count for an authoritative empty transition list, but distinguish missing per-state dwell from explicit returned numeric zero. Preserve all four metrics and independent empty composition/list states.

originalRecord.title: Open transition preview is not bound to its originating vehicle/window
originalRecord.mechanism: previewTransition stores only a TransitionRow, not the originating vehicle/range/timezone. It is cleared only on close or replaced on inspect; no scope-change reset is present. A mounted workspace selection/range change therefore leaves old event fields visible while previewDay/recorded time use the new timezone and the Vehicle action uses the new vehicleId.
originalRecord.owner: Narrow TimelinePage preview-scope owner with directly covering page tests.
originalRecord.proposed_scope: Reset or explicitly bind retained preview evidence/actions to the originating scope on vehicle/window changes, using existing drawer and workspace ownership.
originalRecord.runtime_status: Interaction reproduction NOTRUN; incompatible state/prop dependencies are source-confirmed.

originalRecord.title: Daily transition classifications omit unknown states and under-disclose grouped states
originalRecord.mechanism: Only eight fixed destination strings increment the four daily buckets. Every other to_state leaves a day row with no increment, so returned unknown/new states remain in the transition table but are silently absent from daily counts. The displayed Sleeping series also includes offline, and Idle includes online/parked, without visible classification disclosure; the UTC subtitle describes time grouping only.
originalRecord.owner: Narrow TimelinePage daily-classification/disclosure owner; product/FSM owner decides authoritative group meaning.
originalRecord.proposed_scope: Retain raw transitions and existing series identities; make unclassified evidence visible and explain existing grouping instead of reclassifying offline as measured sleep. Do not silently change domain semantics.
originalRecord.runtime_status: Observed production state vocabulary NOTRUN; the fixed mapping and omission mechanism are confirmed source facts.

originalRecord.title: Specialist duration display bypasses effective numeric locale
originalRecord.mechanism: Duration formatters interpolate JS integers directly into h/m/s strings. Operational duration callbacks ignore the effective formatter preferences argument. Thus duration digits remain ordinary JS decimal text even when the number locale changes, while dates and percentages honor the subscribed locale.
originalRecord.owner: Narrow TimelinePage display adapter owner, reusing existing formatting/i18n owners rather than creating another formatter engine.
originalRecord.proposed_scope: Preserve once-only minute rounding and seconds thresholds while applying effective locale and agreed compact duration-unit labels at the display boundary.

originalRecord.title: Finite negative dwell can be represented as a valid zero duration
originalRecord.mechanism: The page's custom duration formatter maps seconds <= 0 to 0m. Its display options use formatter but do not set durationStyle=roundedMinutes. The shared formatter rejects finite negative duration only for that named style before invoking a custom formatter, so a negative finite raw dwell can yield valueState=value with 0m; the time-by-state positive filter simultaneously drops the row. Healthy repository output clamps negatives, so this finding concerns the page's malformed-source handling rather than claiming bad persisted values exist.
originalRecord.owner: Narrow TimelinePage numeric-evidence validation owner; shared formatter contract owner only if a separately authorized cross-consumer change is needed.
originalRecord.proposed_scope: Keep explicit zero valid, preserve raw evidence and distinguish invalid negative dwell without hiding sections or weakening specialist rounding.
originalRecord.runtime_status: Malformed payload injection NOTRUN; conditional control-flow mechanism is source-confirmed.

confirmed_findings.title: Final transition dwell extends historical windows to wall-clock now
confirmed_findings.mechanism: The final in-window row always has next_ts=null, and transitionDuration uses Date.now rather than the requested exclusive end or an evidence-backed successor. For a past window the table/mobile/preview duration keeps extending after that window and can disagree with bounded summary suffix dwell. Absence of a successor inside a bounded query does not establish current state.

confirmed_findings.runtime_status: NOTRUN; Date.now and missing successor construction are directly observed source.

confirmed_findings.title: Unavailable dwell evidence becomes zero-valued summary duration
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Array.isArray(by_state) alone makes summarySource available. Missing driving/charging/grouped state rows become 0 via ?? 0, and an empty by_state makes all dwell metrics show 0m. The repository returns []/0 when there are no in-window transitions, not a continuous zero-dwell observation; a null first from_state also leaves prefix coverage unknown. The page already labels observation completeness unknown, so array availability is insufficient evidence for per-state measured-zero dwell.

confirmed_findings.proposed_scope: Keep zero transition count for an authoritative empty transition list, but distinguish missing per-state dwell from explicit returned numeric zero. Preserve all four metrics and independent empty composition/list states.

confirmed_findings.title: Open transition preview is not bound to its originating vehicle/window
confirmed_findings.mechanism: previewTransition stores only a TransitionRow, not the originating vehicle/range/timezone. It is cleared only on close or replaced on inspect; no scope-change reset is present. A mounted workspace selection/range change therefore leaves old event fields visible while previewDay/recorded time use the new timezone and the Vehicle action uses the new vehicleId.
confirmed_findings.owner: Narrow TimelinePage preview-scope owner with directly covering page tests.

confirmed_findings.title: Daily transition classifications omit unknown states and under-disclose grouped states
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Only eight fixed destination strings increment the four daily buckets. Every other to_state leaves a day row with no increment, so returned unknown/new states remain in the transition table but are silently absent from daily counts. The displayed Sleeping series also includes offline, and Idle includes online/parked, without visible classification disclosure; the UTC subtitle describes time grouping only.

confirmed_findings.runtime_status: Observed production state vocabulary NOTRUN; the fixed mapping and omission mechanism are confirmed source facts.

confirmed_findings.title: Specialist duration display bypasses effective numeric locale
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Duration formatters interpolate JS integers directly into h/m/s strings. Operational duration callbacks ignore the effective formatter preferences argument. Thus duration digits remain ordinary JS decimal text even when the number locale changes, while dates and percentages honor the subscribed locale.
confirmed_findings.owner: Narrow TimelinePage display adapter owner, reusing existing formatting/i18n owners rather than creating another formatter engine.
confirmed_findings.proposed_scope: Preserve once-only minute rounding and seconds thresholds while applying effective locale and agreed compact duration-unit labels at the display boundary.

confirmed_findings.category: conditional malformed-source hardening, not observed production corruption
confirmed_findings.title: Finite negative dwell can be represented as a valid zero duration
confirmed_findings.mechanism: The page's custom duration formatter maps seconds <= 0 to 0m. Its display options use formatter but do not set durationStyle=roundedMinutes. The shared formatter rejects finite negative duration only for that named style before invoking a custom formatter, so a negative finite raw dwell can yield valueState=value with 0m; the time-by-state positive filter simultaneously drops the row. Healthy repository output clamps negatives, so this finding concerns the page's malformed-source handling rather than claiming bad persisted values exist.
confirmed_findings.owner: Narrow TimelinePage numeric-evidence validation owner; shared formatter contract owner only if a separately authorized cross-consumer change is needed.
confirmed_findings.proposed_scope: Keep explicit zero valid, preserve raw evidence and distinguish invalid negative dwell without hiding sections or weakening specialist rounding.
confirmed_findings.runtime_status: Malformed payload injection NOTRUN; conditional control-flow mechanism is source-confirmed.

originalRecord.title: Fixed-ledger all-in value turns unavailable independent inputs into measured totals
originalRecord.mechanism: Page passes missing aggregate distance/cost as zero. Ledger adds grand_total ?? 0 and renders the all-in header before its own loading/fatal branch. Thus missing/failed aggregate with a ready ledger becomes fixed-only 'All-in'; missing ledger with a ready aggregate becomes charging-only 'All-in'; neither source can qualify the headline. With no vehicle or initial paused ledger, isLoading is false and no fetchStatus/enabled gate exists: an empty directory and zero hint can be shown despite no authoritative empty response.
originalRecord.source_repro_condition: Aggregate data undefined while ledger has entries; or ledger data undefined during loading/failure/paused/no-selection. Algebra and branch ordering establish the defect; no mounted repro executed.

originalRecord.title: Ledger currency dimension is discarded in display, creation and combined totals
originalRecord.mechanism: Entry currency survives only in filter identity; visible amount uses the current currency symbol regardless of e.currency, without conversion. Add payload omits currency, so server stores USD independently of the displayed symbol. SummarizeLedger combines all currencies into a dimensionless grand_total, which the frontend adds to charging spend; charging aggregate exposes no ISO currency dimension. A symbol preference is not an ISO code or an exchange rate.
originalRecord.source_repro_condition: A non-USD display symbol, an entry with a different ISO currency, or mixed-currency entries. Source branch/schema inspection only, not actual financial data.

originalRecord.proposed_narrow_owner: Parent-assigned currency-contract integration owner first, plus narrowly scoped ledger consumption. page.purpose: Lifetime vehicle operating-cost evidence: recorded positive-cost charging versus modeled gasoline, with distinct fixed-cost ledger and opt-in narration. It is not measured complete ownership cost.
page.comparison_limit: 209 is the queue's historical page-only baseline. No historical extracted-component total was reconstructed or claimed. Current closure includes directly rendered feature parts, state/display/type support and the pure analysis adapter, excluding tests, barrels and unused former equivalents.
page.section_preservation: All seventeen slots are declared unconditionally in one CardGrid; each is independently wrapped by SectionErrorBoundary. No whole-page loading/error/empty props replace the children: PageLayout receives only the aggregate query for header freshness.

section_order.contract: Eight raw numeric KPIs with distinct source filters, lifetime/span captions and aggregate retry/trust notice.
Endpoint, charging/drive/month filters, payload and row dispositions.
Always-present operating versus ownership boundary; zero-floor withholding.
Signed fuel delta, separate maintenance heuristic, qualified combination.
Independent entries/totals, add form and confirmed deletion; findings below.
Supported monthly cumulative gas-minus-EV, source export and formatted data alternative.
Paired supported EV/gas rows, legend visibility identity and export.
Signed deltas, explicit zero line and export.
Cost and converted Wh series, separate axes and raw-Wh export.
Lifetime distance denominator converted at display, source cost/km export.
Every returned row with terminal disposition and independently validated fields.
Source fuel price/unit/MPG/rate, monthly energy method and heuristic.
First/last positive drives, modeled span, returned month range and disclosed gap meaning.
Algebraic baseline-supported price/MPG thresholds, not forecast.
Nine bounded price/MPG scenarios; mobile omission finding below.
Eight identities with expected/observed/residual/tolerance and unavailable operands.
Eight always-visible limitations including negative losses and database-calendar semantics.

confirmed_findings.title: Fixed-ledger all-in value turns unavailable independent inputs into measured totals
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Page passes missing aggregate distance/cost as zero. Ledger adds grand_total ?? 0 and renders the all-in header before its own loading/fatal branch. Thus missing/failed aggregate with a ready ledger becomes fixed-only 'All-in'; missing ledger with a ready aggregate becomes charging-only 'All-in'; neither source can qualify the headline. With no vehicle or initial paused ledger, isLoading is false and no fetchStatus/enabled gate exists: an empty directory and zero hint can be shown despite no authoritative empty response.

confirmed_findings.title: Ledger currency dimension is discarded in display, creation and combined totals
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Entry currency survives only in filter identity; visible amount uses the current currency symbol regardless of e.currency, without conversion. Add payload omits currency, so server stores USD independently of the displayed symbol. SummarizeLedger combines all currencies into a dimensionless grand_total, which the frontend adds to charging spend; charging aggregate exposes no ISO currency dimension. A symbol preference is not an ISO code or an exchange rate.
confirmed_findings.source_repro_condition: A non-USD display symbol, an entry with a different ISO currency, or mixed-currency entries. Source branch/schema inspection only, not actual financial data.

sourceConfirmedFindings.title: Absent SOC measurements in returned sessions become measured zero
evidence: useWeeklyDigest.ts:24-31 averagePresent returns 0 for no finite measurements

sourceConfirmedFindings.mechanism: One returned session with both SOC fields null passes hasData and renders 0%/0%/0% gain. sourceConfirmedFindings.sourceRepro: Trace a single in-week charging session with null start_soc_pct/end_soc_pct through averagePresent, hasData and meter props; compare an actual numeric 0 session, which must remain valid.
sourceConfirmedFindings.proposedNarrowFix: Parent queue exact nullable-average view-model/panel handling with focused null/partial/measured-zero tests; retain charge count, energy, source retention and paused charging behavior.

evidence: DrivingPanel.tsx:59-98,145,161 details are independent of plot loading/error

useWeeklyDigest.ts:239-244 null energy is safeNumber zero

After a payload returns, a null energy measurement is still zeroed. presentedMetric converts all specialist numeric measurements to text and therefore bypasses formatMetric's numeric/missing validation.
sourceConfirmedFindings.sourceRepro: Trace no retained drive/charge payload plus isLoading=true into unconditional detail StatGroup; then trace a returned drive with energyUsedWh=null. This is not a new rendered test.

Preserve independently available detail/top-drive content and every accepted retained-source behavior; never gate the whole page or rewrite unrelated children.

sourceConfirmedFindings.title: Fun-fact multiplier reparses a localized display string as a number
evidence: formatMetric.ts:35-38 rejects nonfinite raw input before formatter
sourceConfirmedFindings.mechanism: Comma-decimal or grouped locale strings are not JavaScript numeric literals. For example the source can produce '1,40', whose Number conversion is NaN; the validated multiplier becomes unavailable even though its underlying numeric ratio is known.
sourceConfirmedFindings.sourceRepro: Follow any non-integer city-distance ratio under a comma-decimal locale from fmtNumber into Number. No executed calculation/test is claimed.
sourceConfirmedFindings.proposedNarrowFix: Parent queue only raw numeric fun-fact multiplier propagation and its exact summary/type producers with focused locale cases. Keep existing formatted specialist label/context, city-pair logic and threshold.

sourceConfirmedFindings.title: Child localization contract is incomplete for data labels, dates and unit-bearing title keys
evidence: useWeeklyDigest.ts:320,331 carries those labels directly to charts
useWeeklyDigest.ts:75 and DrivingPanel.tsx:108 call dates without locale
dateFormat.ts:44-50,65-82 defaults absent locale to browser
DrivingPanel.tsx:140 and ChargingPanel.tsx:106 call unit-bearing title keys without unit
C10 canonical dailyDistance='Daily distance ({{unit}})' and dailyEnergyAdded='Daily energy added ({{unit}})'
sourceConfirmedFindings.mechanism: Translated chrome surrounds English weekday/severity data; selected numeric locale is not passed to date labels. Canonical title keys require unit interpolation but the title call sites omit it, while subtitle/data-column calls supply it.
sourceConfirmedFindings.sourceRepro: Trace a non-English UI/settings locale differing from the browser; inspect title translation arguments against the canonical leaf. Exact i18next warning/output under missing interpolation is NOTRUN.
sourceConfirmedFindings.proposedNarrowFix: Parent queue exact child label/date/unit-key call-site corrections, including canonical catalog integration only if genuinely needed and exclusively claimed. Preserve raw severity/weekday identities, ordering, chart values and physical units.

sourceConfirmedFindings.title: Flat week-over-week change is forced into favorable green
evidence: DigestTrend.tsx:30-37 tests positive before flat neutral branch
sourceConfirmedFindings.mechanism: For equal current/prior values, the comparison neutral-flat color branch is unreachable because positive=true wins. A no-change state becomes success-colored independent of the metric's business direction.
sourceConfirmedFindings.sourceRepro: Follow equal current and previous operands through trendFor into DigestTrend's non-highlight class conditional.
sourceConfirmedFindings.proposedNarrowFix: Parent queue only neutral-flat precedence at the existing trend owner and focused equal/signed/inverted cases. Preserve direction, percent, accessibility description and non-flat favorability; visual contrast still needs native review.
